title: City Lawsuits Against Power Company
summary:
*   Austin leaders convened a special, private meeting to discuss ongoing legal challenges.
*   The primary agenda item was sensitive pending litigation involving the City and Houston Lighting and Power Company.
*   Discussions included two specific lawsuits: one where Austin was suing Houston Lighting and Power, and another related case in Matagorda County.
*   All council members were present for the confidential executive session to address these legal matters.
